title: Taken unknowingly to the hangar building with an EG&G escort

tellings.quote: >> Um, my EGNG escort knew I was going to uh that building that day, but um

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who has been described as working with NASA, says that around 2000 he was taken to a secret hangar building at a base he doesn't name, without being told beforehand where he was going. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that his escort, who came from EG&G, a defence contractor, knew in advance that he would be going to that building that day. He tells it as the start of how he says he came to see an unusual craft hidden inside, which would mean such things are kept out of public view.
